prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_returning_user_pet_restore_hint: Display a hint on the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that logging in with their existing account automatically restores all previously saved pets.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing into your existing account automatically restores all your saved pets and desktop preferences."}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] adoption_care_instructions_new_screen: Insert a new screen before adoption confirmation detailing essential daily pet care routines and desktop interaction basics.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_care_instructions", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}, "new_care_instructions": {"headline": "How to Care for Your Pet", "body": "Learn the basics of feeding, playing, and managing your companion on your desktop.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "checklist", "text": "Click to play, drag to reposition, right-click for settings menu."}]}}
2: [home, wait_info] waiting_pet_rendering_checklist_wait_info: Provide status updates on screen resolution checks and rendering progress on the waiting screen while the pet is loaded.
   config: {"waiting": {"body": "Preparing your desktop pet... Checking screen resolution and asset rendering.", "show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 10}}
3: [adoption, new_screen] upload_photos_validation_tips_new_screen: Add a dedicated photo verification screen before pet generation to ensure photo lighting and angle yield good 3D pet rendering.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_validation", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}, "new_photo_validation": {"headline": "Photo Quality Check", "body": "Ensure clear lighting and front-facing photos for optimal 3D pet rendering.", "layout": "card"}}
4: [finish, hint] home_intro_desktop_toggle_guide_hint: Add a quick hint on the home intro screen detailing hotkeys to show, hide, and reposition the pet on the desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Press Ctrl+Shift+P to instantly show or hide your pet on your desktop."}}
5: [choose_path, copy] story_companion_selection_copy: Update the story screen body copy to emphasize the choice between pre-made animated companions and custom photo-based pets.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Choose from a gallery of ready-to-play pets or generate a custom pet from your own photos."}}
6: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_split_preview_redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split layout separating personality traits on one side from live animated previews on the other.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Friend", "body": "Select a companion to see their live animations and unique personalities."}}
7: [home, wait_info] waiting_desktop_launch_status_wait_info: Display explicit instructions on the waiting screen on how to check the system tray icon if the pet does not immediately appear on desktop.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "If your pet does not appear on screen in 30 seconds, check your system tray menu to enable overlay mode."}}
8: [sign_in, copy] sign_in_account_data_safety_copy: Update sign-in headline and body text to affirm that signing in secures existing pet data and cloud saves.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Protect Your Pets", "body": "Logging into your account securely backs up your companion data and restores previously adopted pets."}}
9: [finish, new_flow] home_intro_pet_interaction_new_flow: Insert a brief interactive demonstration step into the home intro flow requiring users to try dragging and right-clicking their pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_interaction_demo", "home_intro"]}, "new_interaction_demo": {"headline": "Quick Desktop Practice", "body": "Try moving your pet and opening the quick menu to complete onboarding.", "layout": "centered"}}

verdicts.reason: Adding a sign-in hint for returning users is allowed within onboarding.
Adding a new care instructions screen within onboarding is permitted.
Displaying rendering status and real wait time estimates on the waiting screen is allowed.
Adding a photo validation check screen within onboarding is valid.
Adding desktop hotkey instructions to the home intro hint is allowed.
Updating story copy while continuing to introduce the pet is valid.
Redesigning the pet selection screen layout within onboarding is permitted.
Adding a troubleshooting hint on the waiting screen is allowed.
Updating sign-in screen copy regarding account backup is valid.
Adding an interactive demonstration step to the onboarding flow is allowed.
